meaning: A phone line shared by several homes. When a neighbor was talking, you had to wait.
clues: It was something neighbors had to share.
Each house had its own phone, but all the phones were on the same line.
If a neighbor was already talking, you had to wait your turn.
Each home had its own ring pattern, like one long and one short, so you knew which calls were yours.
It has two words. The first is a word for a celebration.
assumes: A payphone is a public phone you pay to use
A switchboard operator connected calls by hand
Caller ID shows who is calling

decoys.meaning: A public phone that you pay to use, found on streets and in stores.
A worker who connected phone calls by hand, plugging cords into a board.
A phone feature that shows who is calling before you pick up.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Everyone knew your business! A neighbor could pick up and listen in. News traveled fast.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Today's version: your own private phone number. And a group chat when everyone should hear the news.
